title: The Starfish Mold and the Dry Sand
youtube_title: The Starfish Mold and the Dry Sand | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience finds the right dampness and lets careful work hold together.
summary: Nico's starfish-shaped sand mold keeps crumbling in the dry upper sand until he waits for the damp tide line and packs it slowly enough to stand.
